description:
## Current delivery contract — user-approved two-outcome stack
Owner: PR A/B coordination. One PR per complete outcome, NOT one PR per bead. Keep detailed beads and cohesive internal commits for tracking; consolidate existing draft foundations into their owning feature PR where practical. PR B stacks on independently usable PR A. Include owning PR documentation and validation there. This supersedes earlier per-bead/prerequisite PR instructions and historical comments. Closed foundation status is not outcome acceptance.

Planning/execution handoff for user-approved two-PR topology: inventory live refs/CI/ancestry and uncommitted work before changes; map draft foundations #799/#800/#806/#807/#808/#811/#812/#813 and any later work by actual diff, not bead status. Prefer reuse/consolidation into A (history/access) and B (runtime/delivery), B based on A; no more prerequisite-only PRs. Preserve commit provenance, reviews and tests; identify mixed commits and allocate fixes to owning outcome. Canonical storage/grants/strategies/provider facts go to A; runtime-reference/terminal-delivery fixes and private execution state go to B unless a minimal additive schema is demonstrably needed to preserve A migration data. Record any such exception; do not wire live runtime consumption in A. Coordinate active owners before branch/PR mutations; preserve populated DBs and applied migrations. This ticket is not authorization to commit/push/rewrite/close drafts in this planning session. Acceptance: documented actual two-PR mapping, independent A validation, B ancestry on A, no orphan fixes. Action reuse N/A: delivery topology only.

comments.text: Next delivery action: inspect actual live branch contents and any active owners before consolidation; old foundation PR numbers are provenance, not mandated future topology. Reuse/retarget practical existing PRs for A and B, record superseded drafts only after safe consolidation. This planning request updates Beadwork only; no GitHub PRs or Git branches were changed. Preserve all existing work and databases.

Live non-destructive inventory (current fetch): eight draft PRs #799/#800/#806/#807/#808/#811/#812/#813 form a strictly stacked chain, #799 based on main; current #813 HEAD 998b03ea8 is clean before this slice. PR A candidates: #799 connector routing, #800 grant/author foundation, #806 watch-scoping needed by author/connector lifecycle, #807 schema, #808 authorized transcript API, #812 typed strategy, #813 trusted kind. PR B candidate: #811 bda9dcc21 private execution migration/schema plus ordered delivery-timeout regression 84ff37a11 currently embedded in #799 ancestor (duplicative sync commits 8f4e6b22d/24d4560f3 are provenance, not separate features). Preserve migration versions 20260922000013/14 already applied in populated test DB; move only by new ancestry or additive replacement, do not rewrite/replay on existing DB. A clean-DB validation must not rely on B schema; B needs safe ancestry on A. No rebase, retarget, commit or push performed. Current local .14.2.2 changes belong to A. Need coordinate existing worktree ownership and authorize Git/PR mutations before consolidation.

title: [zaq-emb.29] Consolidate existing drafts into outcome PR A and PR B
